title: Never Coast Downhill Like This
hook: Never shift into neutral while driving.

script.narration: Never shift into neutral while driving.
Some drivers think coasting in neutral saves gas down hills. It actually disconnects engine braking, forcing your traditional brakes to work twice as hard and overheat.
Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Did you know this? Comment yes or no. Never shift into neutral while driving.
